hero.title: Love Quiz:
hero.titleHighlight: Are You Truly Made for Each Other?
hero.description: 20 statements to measure the strength of your love. Debate together, find agreement and discover your compatibility score!

seo.whyTitle: Why Take This Love Quiz Together?
seo.whySubtitle: A quiz designed to strengthen your bond and understand each other better.
seo.card1Text: Every statement is an opportunity for discussion. Express your feelings and listen to your partner's.
seo.card2Text: Objectively discover where you stand in your relationship and identify your couple's strengths.
seo.card3Text: Simply taking this quiz together shows your commitment to the relationship. That's already a proof of love!
seo.card4Text: Whatever your score, this quiz allows you to celebrate your story and remember why you're together.
seo.faq1Q: How does this love quiz work?
seo.faq1A: You answer together 20 statements by rating your level of agreement from 1 to 5. Debate if necessary to find a consensus!
seo.faq2Q: How long does the quiz take?
seo.faq2A: About 10 to 15 minutes, depending on how much time you take to discuss each statement. Take your time!
seo.faq3A: Yes, 100% free and no registration required. Your answers are not saved, you can retake the quiz as many times as you want.
seo.faq4A: Your score reflects your level of agreement on key aspects of the relationship. A high score indicates strong harmony, but it's just a fun indicator!
